=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/release_tag_preflight.sh:158-163 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `git diff --name-only` with default rename detection collapses a rename to its destination path, so `git mv .github/workflows/foo.yml scripts/foo.yml` leaves the grep with zero matches and the script emits `result=pass reason=no_workflow_changes`.
  WHY: Deleting a file from `.github/workflows/` still needs the `workflow` scope at push time, so the tag push is rejected after the long release gate. The fix is `--no-renames` plus a rename scenario in the decision-matrix test (`tests/test_mark_stable_release_tag_refspec_contract.py`).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
